verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Stagehand can attach to a local Chromium browser over CDP (localBrowser.connect) and persist local user data on disk, meaning it can run fully locally without Browserbase/cloud accounts; Browserbase is presented as optional rather than required. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of a pure-local run with no cloud account, and clearer docs distinguishing local-only setup from Browserbase defaults.
